integrity: Exact standalone two-method matrix enumeration corroborates a separate general geometric proof; the full prior literature has not been exhaustively surveyed.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers; only the two Miranda--Persson II* extremal rational elliptic surfaces; no statement on Mori chambers, other fiber types, or positive-characteristic models. Historical priority provisional and no independent validation.
title: Only three forbidden negative supports on the two extremal \(II^*\) rational elliptic surfaces
